integrity: The source parametrization by \(\ker(U\mapsto BU^T+UB^T)\) is used as the premise. The new kernel-dimension formula is proved by rank-normal-form reduction and rank-nullity, and a standalone exhaustive checker verifies all binary matrices through \(3\times3\) together with larger canonical forms.
scientific_limitations: The formula counts coordinate-labeled generator-matrix lifts over a fixed shortest binary residue embedding in the source Proposition 5.3 regime. It is not a monomial-equivalence-class count and does not address cases where the shortest quaternary embedding length exceeds the residue embedding length.
title: Exact lift counts for shortest self-orthogonal embeddings over \(\mathbb Z_4\)
